name: Bedroom (upper floor)
foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the sticker frame; draw at left = x - w//2, top = y - h + 1
draw_order: rugs first, then everything by foot y (then x); characters sort with them
slot_state: a slot with "state" is free only in that state; every other slot is free in both
sticker_looks: recolour placed stickers by colour name with looks/palette-rain.json (use the indoor table) or looks/palette-night.json
walkable_note: one string per tile row (0 = blocked: walls, border, furniture; 1 = floor). A floor sticker placed on a slot blocks its own footprint.
